valuation.formula: feeAssets = floor((totalAssets() - lastTotalAssets()) * fee() / 10^18); feeShares = floor(feeAssets * (totalSupply() + 10^6) / (totalAssets() - feeAssets + 10^6)); USDT per 1 token = floor(10^shareDecimals * (totalAssets() + 10^6) / (totalSupply() + feeShares + 10^6)) / 10^18
valuation.methodology: Read convertToAssets() for exactly one whole vault token. Reproduce the integer conversion from native same-block accounting including virtual offsets and, for Earn vaults, accrued fee shares.
limitations: Accounting conversion, not a market price or an executable redemption quote.
Underlying is Binance-Peg USDT on BNB Smart Chain. No USD peg conversion is used.
Active implementation bytecode/source equivalence and complete administrative configuration were not independently established.
Borrow receivables or strategy balances may not be immediately withdrawable.

Euler Earn totalAssets() may include tracked lostAssets; these are accounting balances, not recoverable cash. Pending performance fee shares are included in convertToAssets(), while capitalization uses issued totalSupply().
